name: 2027-28 Teacher Planner (UK school year)

listing.title: 2027-28 Teacher Planner for UK Teachers - Printable Monthly Calendar, September 2027 to August 2028
listing.description:
A dated school-year planner for teachers in the UK.

Inside: a cover, a How to use page, a 2027-28 year-at-a-glance page and 12 monthly calendar pages from September 2027 to August 2028 (weeks start on Monday). Every month page has This month's focus, Key dates and Notes boxes. Two extra pages: a Class Roster page and a Term Overview page for the autumn, spring and summer terms.

Print it on A4 or US Letter paper.

instructions: Print the A4 or US Letter file at 100% (actual size).
Write term dates, half terms and parents’ evenings on the Term Overview page.
Keep the Class Roster page at the front of your folder.
